content:
Dear all,

We seek nominations for members of the community to serve on the OOPSLA 2026 Artifact Evaluation Committee (AEC). We encourage nominations and self-nominations across all levels of seniority and both academia and industry.

AEC members will evaluate artifacts submitted with accepted OOPSLA 2026 papers. It is the goal of the AEC to examine these artifacts and determine whether they are functional, meet the expectations laid out in the paper, and adequately support its central claims. We expect reviewers to review 3-5 artifacts. 

This involves:

  • Installing, running, and verifying artifacts.
  • Validating artifacts for functionality, reusability and reproducibility.
  • Writing reviews and providing recommendations for which badge(s) to award.

Timeline: OOPSLA's two-round review process includes corresponding artifact evaluation rounds:

  • Round 1: February-March 2026
  • Round 2: July-August 2026

Please submit nominations (including self-nominations) via our online form by 15 December 2025: https://forms.gle/E2QJeEvnsTaN5XR5A

For more information on the OOPSLA 2026 AEC and artifact evaluation process, please visit: https://2026.splashcon.org/track/splash-2026-artifact-evaluation

We greatly appreciate your consideration and look forward to building a strong artifact evaluation committee for OOPSLA 2026!

Best regards, 
Eric Atkinson, Satyajit Gokhale, and Simon Oddershede Gregersen.
OOPSLA 2026 Artifact Evaluation Chairs
